Class Sqlca

java.lang.Object
org.cobol4j.Sqlca
public final class Sqlca extends Object
COBOL SQL Communication Area (SQLCA).

After every EXEC SQL statement, COBOL programs check SQLCODE to determine the outcome. This class holds that state.

  • SQLCODE = 0 — successful execution
  • SQLCODE = 100 — no data found (SELECT returned no rows, or FETCH past end)
  • SQLCODE < 0 — error
  • SQLCODE > 0 && != 100 — warning
